Corrected models count all input genomes;active-acceptor normalization did not measure manufactured yield. Ten ideal decoupled binary dimer cells give at most11spectra,not1024functions. No experimental evolution,practical advantage or historical breakthrough. N1673 is a distinct peptide-handoff predecessor.
